summary: A single component ARCH-001 realises REQ-001..REQ-004; data flows with EXTERNAL are consistent and the one NFR/constraint (stdlib only, single module) has a credible approach. No interfaces are needed; the trade-off is justified and system-level verification via the CLI is appropriate.

checklist.item: Every requirement realised by a component

checklist.note: Args and file bytes in; stdout, stderr and exit code out.
REQ-004 mapped to argparse/pathlib/str methods in one module.
One module vs split; no benefit from an internal interface.
Nothing internal to integrate; the external CLI boundary is covered by system tests.

findings.description: ASM-002 leaves invalid UTF-8, directories and unreadable files undefined; acceptable as recorded.

integration_applicability.reason: One component with no internal interfaces; its only boundaries are the external CLI and file, verified by system tests.
